breakdown.description: `dc2` is treated as the interstitial-containing defect complex even though it is built without the H interstitial.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still builds dc2 from only the substitution and vacancy (identical to dc), without including the H interstitial. The docstring even explicitly states this flawed approach: 'Builds dc2 from the same substitution and vacancy only, but treats dc2 as the defect complex that includes the H interstitial when computing interstitial-containing properties.' The ground truth requires dc2 to be constructed from the substitution, vacancy, AND H interstitial as a true three-defect complex. The generated code repeats the original error from the incomplete prompt.
